rationale: The entry rationale was expanding volume into a new session high, but the last five 1m candles show a clear micro-roll-over — lower highs (10.23→10.16→10.12) and lower closes (10.21→10.11) on fading volume — with price now 1.37% below the high and only +0.50% unrealized. With a 59.5 bps spread, negative class-action backdrop, wide $9.93 stop versus a distant $10.50 target, and the momentum edge that justified entry already decayed, locking the small gain is preferable to holding a stalled breakout into the close.
